title: Demand Assessment
sub: For behavior maintained by escape: which demands evoke it, and why. The team lists the student’s demands from the schedule, each task is presented in brief sessions with the same prompting sequence while compliance, latency to the first problem behavior, its rate and the student’s affect are recorded, and the results rank the tasks, name the ones for the demand condition of Form EA-1, and say where demand fading and task modification should start on Form TD-1.
